b.lede: From Elon Musk to Palantir’s Alex Karp, CEOs are softening hardline stances in expectation of an influx of Democrats A short two years ago, Elon Musk stood before an audience of tens of thousands of people in New York City and proudly told them: “I’m not just Maga. I’m dark, gothic Maga.” On Wednesday, Musk spoke with much less conviction.
b.title: Fair-weather Silicon Valley pivots away from the right after blue wave: ‘I’m not Maga’
